_note: Enhancements and Upgrades, keyed by id. Points, Upgrade tags and restrictions match Wahapedia's 11th edition Orks page (read 2026-10-12); the rule text is a summary. Enhancements go on non-Epic-Hero CHARACTER units only; Upgrades are Enhancements that may also go on non-CHARACTER units, up to three copies each. The app applies those gates on top of each entry's own restriction.
_restriction_note: restrictedToKeyword = every keyword must be present. restrictedToAnyKeyword = any one entry matches (a nested array must match in full). excludesKeyword = none may be present. A datasheet's own name counts as a keyword (core rules 02.01.01), so 'BOYZ unit only' matches the Boyz datasheet without BOYZ being printed in its keyword list.
_whileCalled_note: whileCalled: what the Enhancement adds while its unit is riled up by the Waaagh!. Shown on the unit's card while the call is active; the full rule is always in the description.

headwoppas-killchoppa.name: Headwoppa’s Killchoppa
headwoppas-killchoppa.short: +1 AP in melee on a turn its unit charged.
headwoppas-killchoppa.description: ORKS model only. If this unit made a Charge move this turn, this model’s melee attacks have +1 AP.

da-boss-is-watchin.name: Da Boss is Watchin’
da-boss-is-watchin.short: Once per battle: this unit is riled up for a turn.
da-boss-is-watchin.description: ORKS model only. (Once per battle, per army.) In your Movement phase, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.

kunnin-but-brutal.name: Kunnin’ But Brutal
kunnin-but-brutal.short: This unit can shoot and charge after Falling Back.
kunnin-but-brutal.description: ORKS model only. When this unit is selected to make a Fall Back move, that move does not stop it from shooting or declaring a charge.

ferocious-show-off.name: Ferocious Show-off
ferocious-show-off.short: +1 Attack in melee, +2 instead in a unit of 11+ models.
ferocious-show-off.description:
ORKS INFANTRY model only. This model’s melee attacks have:
• +1 A.
• Or: +2 A if this unit has 11 or more models.

ardboyz.name: ’Ardboyz
ardboyz.description: BOYZ unit only. This unit has a 4+ Sv.

wimp-kickaz.name: Wimp-kickaz
wimp-kickaz.short: Enemies falling back from this unit must make a desperate escape.
wimp-kickaz.whileCalled: Enemies making that desperate escape have -1 to their hazard rolls
wimp-kickaz.description:
NOBZ unit only. When an enemy unit engaged with this unit is selected to make a Fall Back move:
• That enemy unit must select the desperate escape mode.
• If this unit is riled up, the hazard rolls made for that desperate escape have -1.

tellyporta-boss.name: Tellyporta Boss
tellyporta-boss.description: MEGA ARMOUR model only. This unit (excluding VEHICLE units) has Deep Strike.

extra-sneaky.name: Extra Sneaky
extra-sneaky.description: GRETCHIN unit only. This unit has -3" detection range.

minefield-detail.name: Minefield Detail
minefield-detail.description: GRETCHIN unit only. While this unit is not embarked, it has Scouts 6".

supa-glowy-fing.name: Supa-glowy Fing
supa-glowy-fing.restriction: ORKS INFANTRY model only (excluding WEIRDBOY models)
supa-glowy-fing.short: Ranged attacks gain Anti-Infantry 4+ and Devastating Wounds, with two hazard rolls.
supa-glowy-fing.description:
ORKS INFANTRY model only (excluding WEIRDBOY models). This model’s ranged attacks have:
• [ANTI-INFANTRY 4+].
• [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].
• [SUPA-HAZARDOUS].

[SUPA-HAZARDOUS] works like [HAZARDOUS] but harsher: after the unit has resolved its shooting, make two hazard rolls for each such weapon it used.

targetin-squigs.name: Targetin’ Squigs
targetin-squigs.short: +3" Range on this unit's ranged attacks (not Torrent).
targetin-squigs.description: BIG MEK, BIGBOSS or WARBOSS model only. This unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [TORRENT] attacks) have +3" Range.

kill-kommanda.name: Kill Kommanda
kill-kommanda._leader_note: The source prints 'LEADER: KOMMANDOS' on this Enhancement. The app cannot change a model's Leader list from an Enhancement, so it is carried in the text.
kill-kommanda.short: Can lead Kommandos; Infiltrators and Stealth while attached.
kill-kommanda.description:
BIG MEK or WARBOSS INFANTRY model only. While this model is part of an Attached unit, it has Infiltrators and Stealth.

Leader: a model with this Enhancement can also be attached to a KOMMANDOS unit.

throat-slittas.name: Throat-slittas
throat-slittas.short: Melee attacks gain Lethal Hits against non-Monster/Vehicle targets.
throat-slittas.description: KOMMANDOS or STORMBOYZ unit only. This unit’s melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE].

kaptins-hat.name: Kaptin’s Hat
kaptins-hat._leader_note: The source prints 'LEADER: FLASH GITZ' on this Enhancement; carried in the text for the same reason as Kill Kommanda.
kaptins-hat.short: Can lead Flash Gitz; redeploy up to three ORKS INFANTRY units.
kaptins-hat.description:
BIG MEK or WARBOSS INFANTRY model only. Once both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly ORKS INFANTRY units. They can be put into Strategic Reserves when you do, however many units are already there.

Leader: a model with this Enhancement can also be attached to a FLASH GITZ unit.

supa-snazz-dakka.name: Supa-snazz Dakka
supa-snazz-dakka.description: FLASH GITZ unit only. This unit’s Snazzgun weapons have [RAPID FIRE 1].

glory-hog.name: Glory Hog
glory-hog.short: This unit can charge after Falling Back.
glory-hog.description: BEAST SNAGGA model only. When this unit is selected to make a Fall Back move, that move does not stop it from declaring a charge.

it-came-from-da-drops.name: It Came from da Drops
it-came-from-da-drops.description: BEASTBOSS ON SQUIGOSAUR model only. This model has +1 T.

mekwaaagh-mastermind.name: Mekwaaagh! Mastermind
mekwaaagh-mastermind.short: This unit is always riled up.
mekwaaagh-mastermind._alwaysCalled_note: 'This unit is riled up' — permanently, so the bearer's card (and the unit it leads) always shows the riled-up effects.
mekwaaagh-mastermind.description: BIG MEK model only. This unit is riled up.

temperamental-shokka.name: Temperamental Shokka
temperamental-shokka.restriction: BIG MEK WITH SHOKK ATTACK GUN model only
temperamental-shokka.restrictedToKeyword: BIG MEK WITH SHOKK ATTACK GUN
temperamental-shokka.short: Optional D6 when shooting: the Shokk Attack Gun misfires, gains an Attack, or gains Sustained Hits 2.
temperamental-shokka.description:
BIG MEK WITH SHOKK ATTACK GUN model only. In your Shooting phase, when this unit is selected to shoot, you can roll one D6:
• 1 — this model’s Shokk Attack Gun has [TORRENT], and once this unit has shot, this model is destroyed.
• 2-5 — this model’s Shokk Attack Gun has +1 A.
• 6 — this model’s Shokk Attack Gun has [SUSTAINED HITS 2].

enhanced-runt-maw.name: Enhanced Runt-maw
enhanced-runt-maw.restriction: BIG MEK WITH SHOKK ATTACK GUN model only
enhanced-runt-maw.restrictedToKeyword: BIG MEK WITH SHOKK ATTACK GUN
enhanced-runt-maw.short: A unit it hits has -1 to Leadership rolls until your next turn.
enhanced-runt-maw.description: BIG MEK WITH SHOKK ATTACK GUN model only. When this unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. Until the start of your next turn that unit is infested with Snotlings: it has -1 to Leadership rolls.

cybork-boosta.name: Cybork Boosta
cybork-boosta.description: BIG MEK or MEK model only. This model has +2" M.

dreadherder.name: Dreadherder
dreadherder.short: Near a Walker: Lone Operative, and one Walker re-rolls Hit rolls of 1.
dreadherder.description:
BIG MEK model only. While this model is within 3" of a friendly ORKS WALKER unit (excluding BIG MEK units):
• This model has Lone Operative.
• In your Shooting phase, you can select one friendly ORKS WALKER unit within 3" of this model. Until the end of the turn, that unit’s attacks can re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

targetin-gizmos.name: Targetin’ Gizmos
targetin-gizmos.short: With a BIG MEK aboard: Ignores Cover, plus Sustained Hits 1 while riled up.
targetin-gizmos.whileCalled: With a BIG MEK embarked, ranged attacks also have [SUSTAINED HITS 1]
targetin-gizmos.description:
WAGON unit only. While a BIG MEK model is embarked within this unit:
• This unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].
• If this unit is riled up, its ranged attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

boss-boomer.name: Boss Boomer
boss-boomer.short: A WARBOSS aboard lends this unit his command ability.
boss-boomer.description: WAGON unit only. While a WARBOSS model is embarked within this unit, this unit has that model’s Intimidating Motivation or Keep Huntin’ ability.

smoky-gubbinz.name: Smoky Gubbinz
smoky-gubbinz.restriction: SPEED FREEKS unit only (excluding AIRCRAFT units)
smoky-gubbinz.short: Units hidden behind this unit get the Benefit of Cover.
smoky-gubbinz.description: SPEED FREEKS unit only (excluding AIRCRAFT units). When an attack targets a unit that is not fully visible to the attacking model because of a model in this unit, the target has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

competitive-streak.name: Competitive Streak
competitive-streak.short: This unit can re-roll Charge rolls.
competitive-streak.description: DEFFKILLA WARTRIKE model only. This unit can re-roll Charge rolls.

flyboss.name: Flyboss
flyboss.short: Becomes a CHARACTER; riles up nearby aircraft when it arrives.
flyboss.description:
ORKS AIRCRAFT unit only.
• This unit has CHARACTER.
• When this unit ends an ingress move, each friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT or DEFFKOPTAS unit within 6" of it is riled up until the start of your next turn.

impulsive-recon.name: Impulsive Recon
impulsive-recon.short: Can make an ingress move in your first Movement phase.
impulsive-recon.description: ORKS AIRCRAFT unit only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

surly-as-a-squiggoth.name: Surly as a Squiggoth
surly-as-a-squiggoth.short: Once per battle: on a 2+ this model gets back up with 3 wounds.
surly-as-a-squiggoth.description: INFANTRY WARBOSS model only. (Once per battle, per army.) At the end of a phase in which this model is destroyed, roll one D6. On a 2+, set this model back up as close as possible to where it was destroyed, unengaged, with 3 wounds remaining.

brutal-but-kunnin.name: Brutal But Kunnin’
brutal-but-kunnin.description: WARBOSS model only. This model’s melee attacks have +1 D.

blitzboss.name: Blitzboss
blitzboss.short: The Transport he rides in gets +2" Move and a 5+ invulnerable save.
blitzboss.description:
WARBOSS model only. A TRANSPORT unit (excluding WALKER units) that this unit is embarked within has:
• +2" M.
• A 5+ invulnerable save.

proper-killy.name: Proper Killy
proper-killy.description: WARBOSS model only. This model can re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

morgogs-finkin-cap.name: Morgog’s Finkin’ Cap
morgogs-finkin-cap.short: Once per battle: a D6" move at the end of the enemy Movement phase.
morgogs-finkin-cap.whileCalled: The D6 for its move can be re-rolled
morgogs-finkin-cap.description: WARBOSS model only. (Once per battle, per army.) At the end of your opponent’s Movement phase, if this unit is unengaged, it can make a Normal move of up to D6". If this unit is riled up, you can re-roll that D6.

da-gobshot-thunderbuss.name: Da Gobshot Thunderbuss
da-gobshot-thunderbuss.short: Gives the bearer a 24" Rapid Fire 6 gun.
da-gobshot-thunderbuss.description: WARBOSS model only. This model has the Da Gobshot Thunderbuss ranged weapon, shown below.

da-krunch.name: Da Krunch
da-krunch.short: Gives the bearer a 24" psychic Blast weapon.
da-krunch.description: ORKS PSYKER model only. This model has the Da Krunch ranged weapon, shown below.

eadbanger.name: ’Eadbanger
eadbanger.short: Gives the bearer a 24" psychic Precision weapon.
eadbanger.description: ORKS PSYKER model only. This model has the ’Eadbanger ranged weapon, shown below.

warphead.name: Warphead
warphead.short: Psyker level 2, Deadly Demise D6, re-roll psychic rolls.
warphead.description:
ORKS PSYKER model only. This model:
• Has psyker level 2.
• Has Deadly Demise D6.
• Can re-roll psychic rolls.
